settings.title: Settings
settings.blurb: Manage your school, profile and system preferences
settings.noAdmins: No admin or bursar accounts yet.
settings.idCardExpiryBlurb: When student ID cards expire. Cards print the academic year this date falls in — "2025/2026", not the date itself. Leave it empty and cards expire at the end of the current academic year.
settings.expiryDefaulting: Cards will be valid until {{date}}, the end of the academic year.
settings.idCardReprint: This applies to cards printed from now on. Cards already issued keep the year printed on them.
settings.gateMessagesBlurb: What a parent is told when their child's card is scanned at the gate. A school of 500 scanning twice a day is about 20,000 messages a month, so sending every scan is rarely the right choice.
settings.gateNotifyExcHint: A late arrival or a child leaving early. This is the recommended setting.
settings.gateNotifyAllHint: Every arrival and every departure. Expect a high message volume.
settings.lateAfterHint: A child scanned in after this time is reported as late.
settings.earlyBeforeHint: A child scanned out before this time is reported as leaving early.
settings.roleBursarHint: Runs the school finances: fees, payments, receipts, expenses, payroll and financial reports. Cannot change grades, classes, results or these settings.
settings.roleAdminHint: Runs the school: staff and student accounts, classes, subjects, grading, results and every setting on this page.
settings.logoHint: Square image recommended · PNG or JPG · max 2 MB
settings.passwordMin8: Password must be at least 8 characters
settings.accountReadyBody: {{name}} can now sign in as {{role}}. These are their sign-in details.
settings.signsInWithEmail: This is what they sign in with.
settings.mustChangeOnFirstSignIn: They will be asked to choose their own on first sign-in.
settings.emailSentTo: Their details have also been emailed to {{email}}.
settings.emailNotSent: No email was sent, so this password is the only copy — write it down or copy it before closing. Recovering it means resetting the account.
settings.resetPasswordConfirm: Issue a new temporary password for {{name}}? Their current one stops working immediately.
settings.restoreConfirm: Restore {{name}}'s account? Their records come back with it, and a new temporary password is issued.
settings.accountRestoredBody: {{name}} is active again as {{role}}, with everything previously recorded against their account. Give them the password below — the old one no longer works.
settings.gradingBlurb: Cameroon Anglophone system — all marks are on a /20 scale. The pass mark and grade bands below are used when grading exam results.
settings.showGradesHint: When off, report cards show marks, remarks and positions but no letter grade. Averages and pass or fail are unaffected.

permissions.title: Who may do what
permissions.intro: Each role starts with the capabilities its job needs. Adjust them here when your school works differently — a bursar who also runs the gate, or a teacher who should not print transcripts.
permissions.lockedIntro: Some capabilities cannot be changed. They are shown with a lock and the reason, because they are what keeps the roles separate: the person who collects the money is never the person who can change a grade.
permissions.unavailable: Permissions are not available for this school.
permissions.takesEffect: Takes effect on each person's next request — nobody needs to sign in again.

key.quiz.author: Write quizzes and questions
key.fees.waive: Reduce or write off a charge
key.approvals.view: See what is waiting for a decision

note.payroll.setSalary: Never the person who pays it. Somebody who can both raise a salary and pay it is not meaningfully supervised.
note.students.admit: Who joins the school is not a decision that gets delegated.
note.students.delete: Erasing a student record removes the history behind every receipt issued to that family.
note.teachers.manage: Assigning a teacher to a class decides who may enter marks for whom.
note.users.manage: Staff contact details and account state. A role that can manage accounts can create one for itself.
note.exams.manage: Setting papers and locking results is academic authority.
note.results.edit: The most important lock here. The person who collects the fees must never be able to move the grade of the child who paid them.
note.results.publish: Publishing or reissuing supersedes a document a parent may already be holding.
note.reports.manage: The template every report card in the school is rendered from.
note.promotion.run: Rewrites which class every child belongs to — the most consequential act in the system.
note.documents.manage: Includes handing out guardian portal codes, which are credentials.
note.messages.audit: Reading a conversation you are not part of. Recorded, and never granted as a side effect of being able to send one.
note.permissions.manage: A role that can grant itself capabilities has no ceiling, and neither does anybody it appoints.
note.sync.push: Writes period definitions and promotion decisions straight from a device.
note.students.view: Names, admission numbers, classes and guardian contacts. No marks.
note.gate.scan: In a small school the person on the gate at eight in the morning is whoever is standing there.
note.approvals.decide: Never the person who raised the request — that is enforced per request, by user, and holds for a super admin too.
note.approvals.configure: The amounts above which a second signature is required.
note.settings.manage: Grading, the academic year, ID cards. These decide how every mark in the school is interpreted.
note.students.viewFull: The whole record in the admission console, as opposed to the roster fields the fee desk needs.
note.fees.refund: Above the school's refund threshold this raises a request instead of paying the money out.
note.fees.waive: Above the waiver threshold this raises a request instead of reducing the bill.
note.fees.penalize: Adds money to a family's bill, so it is never automatic — the bursar raises them from a preview.
note.fees.plan: Changes when fees are due, never how much is owed. A family keeping to a plan is not chased and not charged late fees.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.blurbDecider: Requests waiting for your decision, and everything already decided.
approvals.blurbRequester: Requests you have raised, and where each one stands.
approvals.notApplied: This was approved but could not be carried out: {{error}}
approvals.rejectBlurb: {{what}} — {{amount}}. The person who raised it will see your reason.
approvals.decisionFailed: The decision could not be saved
approvals.withdrawFailed: The request could not be withdrawn
approvals.recordedNotApplied: Recorded, but it did not take effect
approvals.cannotDecideOwn: You raised this, so somebody else has to decide it
approvals.noneWaiting: Nothing is waiting for a decision
approvals.noneWaitingHint: Requests appear here when an amount goes over one of your approval thresholds.

approvalSettings.title: When a second signature is needed
approvalSettings.intro: Set the amount above which an expense, a refund or a fee waiver has to be approved by somebody else before it takes effect. Leave a field empty to never require approval for it.
approvalSettings.fourEyes: Whoever raises a request can never be the one to approve it — not even an administrator approving their own. That rule is what the thresholds are for.
approvalSettings.allOff: No approvals are required at the moment. Anybody who can record an expense, refund or waiver can do it alone, and nothing is held for a second signature.
approvalSettings.invalid: Enter a whole number of XAF, or leave it empty
approvalSettings.recommendation: A useful starting point is roughly one term of fees for one student: large enough that day-to-day spending is not held up, small enough that anything unusual is seen. Enter 0 to require approval every time.
approvalSettings.payrollRequired: A payroll run must be approved before it can be paid
approvalSettings.payrollHint: The person who prepares the payroll then cannot also be the one who releases it. Without this, whoever generates a run can confirm it alone.
approvalSettings.unavailable: Approval settings are not available for this school.
approvalSettings.takesEffect: Applies to requests raised from now on. Anything already waiting keeps the rule it was raised under.

fees.title: Fees
fees.blurb: What each student has been billed, and what they have paid.
fees.noneOwingHint: Every student in this selection has settled their account.
fees.noChargesHint: Apply a fee structure to this student's class to raise charges.
fees.amountHint: Whole francs only — XAF has no centimes.
fees.referenceHint: Mobile money transaction id, teller slip or cheque number.
fees.reverseBody: This appends a correcting entry of {{amount}}. The original stays on the record.
fees.structuresBlurb: What a class is charged, per year and term. Publish a new one rather than editing a structure already in use.
fees.noStructuresHint: Create one to start billing a class.
fees.optionalHint: Optional items are not billed automatically.
fees.applyBody: Every approved student in the class is billed. Running this twice is safe — charges already raised are left alone.
fees.structureExists: An active structure already exists for that year, class and term.
fees.recordedOffline: Saved on this device. It will reach the server on the next sync, and the receipt number arrives with it.
fees.noClassesYet: No classes yet — create one first
fees.classesHint: Select none to bill every class in the school.
fees.dueDateHint: The last day these fees may be paid without being late. Reminders and late fees are calculated from it.
fees.penaltyPercent: A percentage of what is owed
fees.penaltyRateHint: Of whatever is still unpaid when it is applied
fees.penaltyGraceHint: Days after the due date before a late fee may be added
fees.activate: Could not activate the fee structure

chase.title: Chasing what is owed
chase.blurb: Remind families about outstanding fees, or add the late fee your fee structure defines. Both show you the list first.
chase.modeHint: Overdue means the due date has passed. Due soon looks two weeks ahead.
chase.noContact: No phone or email on file
chase.forceHint: Sends to families already reminded recently.
chase.remindFailed: The reminders could not be sent
chase.penaliseWarning: This adds a charge to each family's bill. It cannot be undone from here — a late fee raised in error has to be voided on the student's account.
chase.nobodyToPenaliseHint: A late fee appears here once a fee structure with a late-fee rule has passed its due date and its grace period.
chase.penaltyFailed: The late fees could not be added

plan.title: Instalment plan
plan.none: This family pays the whole balance by the due date on their fee structure.
plan.agreeBlurb: Split the {{amount}} outstanding across several dates. This changes when the fees are due, not how much is owed — use a waiver to reduce a bill.
plan.totalMatches: The instalments match what is outstanding
plan.totalMismatch: The instalments come to {{planned}}, but {{outstanding}} is outstanding
plan.reason: Why the school agreed to this
plan.reasonHint: Asked about a year later by an auditor, or by the next bursar deciding whether to grant another.
plan.reasonPlaceholder: Hardship — father lost work, agreed with the head
plan.agreeFailed: The plan could not be saved
plan.onTrackHint: While this family keeps to the plan they are not sent reminders and not charged late fees.
plan.behindHint: They have fallen behind the agreed schedule, so reminders and late fees apply again.
plan.cancelBlurb: From now on this family is measured against the original due date on their fee structure, which means reminders and late fees apply as normal. The plan stays on the record.
plan.cancelPlaceholder: Stopped paying, no contact since November
plan.cancelFailed: The plan could not be cancelled

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.blurb: Money going out, by category. A mistake is voided, never deleted.
expenses.noneHint: Record one to start tracking what the school spends.
expenses.noCategories: No categories yet — create one first
expenses.voidBody: The row stays on the record and stops counting toward totals.
expenses.cancelBody: It has not reached the server yet, so it can be removed outright rather than voided.
expenses.cancelTooLate: It reached the server first — void it instead.

salaries.title: Salaries
salaries.blurb: What each staff member is owed monthly. A raise closes the old figure rather than overwriting it, so past payslips stay true.
salaries.noneHint: Set a salary for a staff member before running payroll.
salaries.replaceWarning: This replaces the current salary from that date. The old figure is kept for past payslips.
salaries.readOnlyNote: You can see salaries in order to prepare the payroll. Setting what somebody is paid is an administrator's decision.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.blurb: Generate a month, check it, then confirm. Nobody is paid until you confirm.
payroll.noneHint: Generate a month to produce draft payslips.
payroll.confirmBody: Every draft payslip becomes a payment and is given a payslip number. Reversing afterwards is possible but leaves both entries on the record.
payroll.reverseBody: A mirror payslip is added for every row. The originals stay exactly as issued.
payroll.noStructures: No salaries are set for that month. Set salaries first.
payroll.draftNotice: These are drafts. Nobody has been paid yet.
payroll.readOnlyNotice: Payroll is generated and confirmed in the web console.
payroll.offlineRuns: No signal — showing the last figures this phone fetched.

finrep.title: Financial reports
finrep.blurb: What came in and what went out. Every figure is summed from the ledger when you open this page — nothing here is stored.
finrep.noDataHint: Widen the period, or record a payment or an expense.
finrep.arrearsNote: As it stands today, not for the period above — a debt raised in October is still owed in March.
finrep.offline: No signal — showing the last figures this phone fetched.
finrep.readOnlyNotice: Summed from the ledger. Nothing here can be edited.

prog.title: Class progression
prog.blurb: Which class each one leads to. Stated here once, because it cannot be guessed from the names — nothing in "Form 5" says the next stop is "Lower Sixth".
prog.finalYearHint: Students here leave at the end of the year.
prog.incompleteHint: Their students cannot be promoted until this is set.

promo.title: End of year
promo.blurb: Move everyone up a year. Generated as a proposal, reviewed, then committed — nothing changes until you commit.
promo.noneHint: Set the class progression first, then start one.
promo.draftNotice: This is a proposal. No student has been moved.
promo.blockedNotice: {{count}} student has no destination. Decide those before committing.
promo.blockedNotice_other: {{count}} students have no destination. Decide those before committing.
promo.commitBody: Every student on this list moves. Leavers come off the register. This can be reversed, but it touches the whole school at once.
promo.reverseBody: Every student goes back to the class they were in, and leavers return to the register.
promo.discardBody: Nothing has been applied, so nothing is lost. You can generate it again.
promo.readOnlyNotice: Rollover is started and committed in the web console.
promo.offline: No signal — showing the last rollover this phone fetched.

doc.title: Printing
doc.blurb: Class lists and transcripts, laid out for A4 and ready for the printer.
doc.offline: No signal — this is the last copy this phone fetched.

cl.title: Class list
cl.plainHint: Names, admission numbers, gender and date of birth.
cl.registerHint: Names with blank columns to tick by hand.
cl.contactsHint: Names with guardian and telephone number.

tr.title: Academic transcript
tr.noResults: No published results for this year
tr.empty: Nothing on record for this student yet
tr.disclaimer: This is a record of results published by the school. It is not a certificate.
tr.searchStudent: Search by name or admission number

exp.title: Spreadsheet exports
exp.blurb: Download the books as Excel files. Voided and reversed entries are included and marked, so a file reconciles against the system rather than disagreeing with it.
exp.empty: Nothing to export for that selection
exp.studentsHint: The roster, with guardians and contact numbers.
exp.arrearsHint: What each student was charged, has paid, and still owes.
exp.expensesHint: Money out, with voided entries marked.
exp.payrollHint: Payslips actually issued. Drafts are left out.
exp.enrollmentsHint: Which class each student sat in, year by year.

portal.title: Parent portal
portal.admissionHint: It is on your child's report card and receipts.
portal.codeHint: The code the school gave you. Capitals and dashes do not matter.
portal.intro: See your child's fees, results and attendance.
portal.noAccount: No password needed. If you have lost your code, ask the school office for a new one.
portal.signInFailed: That admission number and code do not match
portal.locked: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
portal.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
portal.revoked: This access code is no longer valid. Ask the school office.
portal.noResults: No results have been published yet
portal.feeRemindersHint: What you owe and when it's due
portal.notificationHistoryHint: Reminders and confirmations sent to you
portal.chooseRecipient: Who would you like to write to?
portal.noRecipients: There is nobody available to write to.

codes.title: Portal access
codes.blurb: Give a guardian a code to see their child's fees, results and attendance. Codes are shown once — write it down before closing.
codes.revokeBody: The guardian is signed out immediately and the code stops working.
codes.newCodeBody: This is the only time it will be shown. If it is lost, issue a new one.
codes.guardianHint: A name the office will recognise — "Mrs Tem (672 44 79 79)".
codes.pickChildren: Choose the children this code covers
codes.childrenHint: One code covers a whole family, so a parent signs in once.
codes.noAccessHint: Issue one so a parent can see their children's fees, results and attendance.
codes.searchChild: Search by name or admission number

idc.title: ID cards
idc.hint: Ten to an A4 sheet, ready to cut and laminate.
idc.blank: Cards print with a blank photo box where no photo is on file — the usual way these are made.
idc.skipped: {{count}} student has no admission number and is left out
idc.skipped_other: {{count}} students have no admission number and are left out

photo.title: ID card photo
photo.hint: A clear head-and-shoulders picture. This is what prints on the student's ID card. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 3 MB.
photo.removeBody: The ID card will print with a blank photo box instead.

watch.title: Students to watch
watch.blurb: Students whose recorded data over the last {{days}} days says something may be going wrong — attendance, results, homework and fees, read together. Every flag shows its reasons.
watch.highHint: Several signals together — talk to the family this week.
watch.mediumHint: A clear pattern — the class teacher should follow up.
watch.lowHint: One early sign — keep an eye on it.
watch.emptyHint: No student currently trips any signal. Flags appear as attendance, results, homework and fee records come in.
watch.noMatch: No flagged students match these filters
watch.footnote: Built only from records the school already keeps — nothing here asked anyone for extra data entry. Thresholds live in the server's early-warning service.

verif.title: Verifiable documents
verif.hint: Verification codes printed on this student's transcripts and report cards. Anyone holding the paper can check it at the public verify page; revoking a code makes that page answer "withdrawn by the school".
verif.none: No codes issued yet — one is created the first time a transcript or report card is printed.
verif.reasonPh: Reason (optional — shown to whoever checks the code)

gate.title: Gate
gate.aim: Point at the card's QR code
gate.unknownHint: It may have been issued since this device last synced.
gate.cameraWhy: The scanner reads the QR code on each student's ID card.
gate.rosterOffline: Could not refresh the card list. The saved one is still in use.
gate.notifyBlurb: Who gets told when a student is scanned in or out.
gate.notifyOffHint: Scans are recorded but nobody is emailed.
gate.notifyExceptionsHint: A message only for a late arrival or an early departure — the ones a parent acts on.
gate.notifyAllHint: Two messages per student per day. On a paid channel this is the largest cost.

messages.title: Messages
messages.blurb: Conversations with staff, students and parents.
messages.nobodyAvailable: There is nobody you can start a conversation with.

audit.title: Message audit
audit.blurb: Find conversations across the school. Reading one is recorded.
audit.adminOnly: Message auditing is limited to administrators.
audit.participantPh: Participant id — leave blank for the whole school

messages.auditNotice: This read is recorded. Deleted messages are shown in full here — that is the point of an audit — and are not visible to participants.

alerts.noAssignments: No teacher assignments yet — assign teachers to subjects

sync.title: Sending to the school
sync.allSent: Everything here has reached the school.
sync.waitingBody: {{count}} change(s) recorded on this computer have not been sent yet. They will go as soon as there is a connection.
sync.offlineBody: The school's server cannot be reached. Work carries on here and is sent when the connection returns.
sync.discardConfirm: Discard this change? What was recorded on this computer will be removed and never sent.

academicStructure.title: Academic Structure
academicStructure.description: Configure the term and sequence layout for your academic year. Each term has 2 sequences with configurable weights and assessment types.
academicStructure.weightsMustSum: Term weights sum to {{sum}}% — they should total 100%.

termResults.title: Term Results
termResults.description: View and compute term averages from sequence exam scores.
termResults.noResults: No results computed yet. Click Compute to generate term averages.
termResults.staleTitle: {{count}} result is older than the marks behind it
termResults.staleTitle_other: {{count}} results are older than the marks behind them
termResults.staleBody: A sequence mark was changed after this term was computed. The report cards will show the new subject marks but the old term average until you recompute.
termResults.staleRow: A sequence mark for this pupil changed after the term was computed.

annualResults.title: Annual Results
annualResults.description: View and compute annual averages and promotion decisions.
annualResults.noResults: No results computed yet. Click Compute to generate annual averages.
annualResults.staleTitle: {{count}} result is older than the term results behind it
annualResults.staleTitle_other: {{count}} results are older than the term results behind them
annualResults.staleBody: A term was recomputed after this year was. Recompute the year so the annual average and the promotion decision match the terms.
annualResults.staleRow: A term result for this pupil was recomputed after the year was.
